_comment: Member registry. Each entry points at a snapshot the MEMBER hosts and signs; this file only records where to find it. To join, publish your own signed snapshot and open a pull request adding an entry here. Removing your entry removes you from the directory -- this project stores nothing of yours. The registry does NOT vouch for identity; every profile shows identity verification as pending.
